summary: The proof correctly converts the derivative hypotheses into strict lower bounds on the two axis-chord widths, uses the exact support to force the inner chord endpoints to be at least one, and derives valid positive lower bounds for the endpoint, Q, and Minkowski-middle contributions. The sign-cell coefficients, convex containments, segment-addition area identity, southwest-triangle construction, exact arithmetic, and final gate algebra all check out, including cutting-line, equality, and degenerate boundary conventions.
